_meta: Every number a reader could take off each panel: axis ranges as drawn, values marked or annotated, and point counts. Captions are checked against this file. Widths are 183 mm (double column); type is >= 7 pt at final size; the palette is Okabe-Ito.

fig1.caption_hint: a, pipeline from configuration sampling to kappa(nu). b, kappa(nu) at 2000 K, 1200 kg/m^3, first principles vs HITEMP at identical conditions (same ideal-gas broadening pressure), with the line profiles truncated at 50 cm^-1 from line centre -- the delivered convention. The marked ratio depends on that cap (A71): it is 35 at 50 cm^-1, 27 at 200 and 12 at 500.

stage_captions: held out 44.4 meV $\mathrm{\AA}^{-1}$, 7 meV/atom parity 41/58 (bulk/RCB, train)

They are the HELD-OUT split error (44.4 and 7.0 on valid_Default) and come from the training log train_v4_7924966.out, which is not in the pull -- recorded in ed_data/mlip_heldout_errors.json. b.line_list_note: direct line-by-line computation at the true density; 1200 kg/m^3 is above the tabulated ceiling of 1000, so the table would clamp
b.why_two_cut_offs: A91: the line profiles are truncated at the cut-off and renormalised to unit area, so where the true HWHM exceeds it a line becomes a ~2*cut-off-wide rectangle. The comparison does not converge in the cut-off -- these two medians differ by more than 2x -- so the panel shows both rather than quoting one. 50 cm^-1 is the delivered convention every line-list table in the manuscript is built at; 500 cm^-1 is the widest A71 studied
b.single_channel_marker_removed: the 2550 cm^-1 point marker is gone: A91 showed it sat on the pedestal of the line at 2543.07, so it measured the cut-off

fig2.caption_hint: a, Rosseland-mean opacity over the 52 first-principles points, interpolated as the structure model reads it. b, first-principles / line-list ratio against density, coloured by temperature; filled Planck, open Rosseland.

a.display_interpolant: Clough-Tocher C1 on the same 52 points, for display only; the model itself interpolates linearly on a Delaunay triangulation
a.blank_region: outside the convex hull, where the model clamps

b.line_list_asymmetry: the two line lists are not matched in isotopologue coverage: the HITEMP spectra carry isotopologues 1, 2 and 3, the POKAZATEL spectra the main one only. Both use the same ideal-gas broadening pressure and the same band. The minor isotopologues sit mostly in the windows, so they bear on the Rosseland ratio more than the Planck one; the size of that is not measured here and a caption should not imply the two references differ only in their line data
b.pokazatel_matching: matched state by state, not interpolated: POKAZATEL sits on 27 of the 52 first-principles states exactly

fig3.caption_hint: a, Schwarzschild ratio through a 20 M_earth water world for the line list and the composite, both boundaries marked. b, per boundary, the first-principles/line-list kappa_R ratio against the factor that would flip it.

a.sampling_note: the located boundary density shifts by ~1.5% between 1500 and 2000 profile samples; 1500 matches the domain scan and panel b

b.bound_provenance: 1.400 is window_validation.ratio.window, measured against Wannier-centre dipole labels; 3.039 is the largest v5 dilute stretch-band excess over the line list, at (2000 K, 30 kg m^-3)
b.selection: boundaries with first-principles data interpolated, not clamped
b.input_vintage: boundary locations and kappa ratios come from the stored boundary analysis, which predates the 2250/2750 K line-list rows

fig4.caption_hint: (T, rho) plane shaded by the first-principles/HITEMP Rosseland ratio over the 52 first-principles points, with the line-list radiative-convective boundary of 108 scanned planets overlaid, coloured by T_eq. The outline is the first-principles grid extent.

panels.category_rule: filled where the opacity table's own triangulation contains the point, open where the model clamps, with the clamp cause distinguished — the same four categories as ED Fig. 6a
panels.grid_extent: convex hull of the 52 points in (T, log10 rho)
panels.input_vintage: boundary locations come from the stored domain scan, which predates the 2250/2750 K line-list rows; the shading is computed from the current tables. The boundaries lie at 364-1850 K, away from the added rows, and the measured sensitivity of the ratio at the analysed boundaries is recorded in fig3 panel b
